reviews.comment: Dr. Birgisson is one of the best professors I have had at TAMU. He genuinly cares about students wellbeing and performance in his course. His lectures were pretty bad, however, his lecture slides, homeworks , and quizess are enough to help students understand the material. His exams were curved and were extremely similar to quiz questions. The GOAT

Whether you want an easy A, or to actually know the material, this is the professor for you. Dr. Birgisson teaches with alot of enthusiasm and you can tell he is both interested in the material he is teaching and cares about his students. He has notes that are easy to follow and his tests are pretty fair. If you can, definiely take this prof.

If you can take him for CVEN 306, take him! Great professor - asks students for when the best day for the test would be. He reads off slides and doesn't really teach the material too, too well, but if you go to his office hours the days before the test, he will basically tell you what's going to be on it. He's a lenient grader and will help you out

Took him for 305,306. He is a very nice and understanding person that tries to help the best he can. His lectures are honestly useless but he tells you what to know and also gives easy quizzes based on hw that are literally the same problems. Tests were hard because of the courses but he curved heavily.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Although he just reads off lecture slides, Bjorn is a really caring professor. He wants you to learn the material and do well in the class. There are weekly quizzes that are straightforward and usually from the homework problem set due that week. The final was 50 multiple choice, but straightforward and he had a review session for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: Despite the lectures being a little dry, it's obvious that he cares about teaching. He consistently tries to work with the students on scheduling of reviews, homework, etc. The only downside is that he gives a lot of assignments which aren't worth a whole lot and take up a lot of time. Overall highly recommended

Although his lectures were boring since he just reads off slides, he's a very caring professor. He makes sure you get the best grade possible in his class. He has weekly quizzes that are similar to the online hw. The final is multiple choice and slightly difficult. He's a very nice guy.

Bjorn is the best prof to take for 306. He makes the class incredibly easy and tests were easy. He's insanely nice and very understanding with late work. HW and Labs always get extensions so you have plenty of time to do it
THE LAST POST ABOUR BJORN IS A LIE. HE IS THE KINDEST MAN ON EARTH AND PASSIONATE ABOUT HIS STUDENTS. A GREAT PROF
Just reads off powerpoints, doesn't really teach. Tests and quizzes are okay
